abstract: Duolingo reduced its contractor workforce by over 10% as part of a strategic shift toward AI-generated content creation. The company's CEO announced an 'AI-first' strategy for all content production, directly replacing human content creators with artificial intelligence systems for language exercise development.
keyFindings: Duolingo cut more than 10% of its contractor workforce
Human content creators are being replaced by AI-generated language exercises
The company announced an 'AI-first' strategy for all content production
methodology: Not specified. This appears to be a corporate announcement rather than a research study.
qualifiers: The source material is limited to a brief excerpt from a blog post. The exact number of contractors affected, timeline for implementation, and specific details about the AI-first strategy are not provided in the available text. The scope appears limited to Duolingo's internal operations.
